 Live .  4,242 viewing 4242 viewing Championship: Wrexham swiftly level against Wolves, while Portsmouth and Norwich also lead
 Live Reporting (active) 
 Scores 
 Tables 
 Summary
 Wrexham's O'Brien quickly cancels out Armstrong's Wolves opener 
 Portsmouth lead Stoke through Shade strike 
 Maghoma puts Norwich ahead at Bristol City
 Eight matches follow at 15:00, including leaders Middlesbrough at Watford
 Plus Cardiff v Burnley, Birmingham v Swansea, Blackburn v West Ham
 Get Involved: Use yellow button
 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Kate Holloway, Alex Hoad, Ben Kosky and Deepak Mahay
 Most recent Most popular get involved Get Involved published at 13:26 GMT 13:26 GMT 
 Use yellow button on page 
 Norwich did well to sweep up Maghoma from Brentford - top quality player really proving his worth of late!
 Harry, Norfolk 
 1 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Potters left in the Shade published at 13:24 GMT 13:24 GMT 
 HT: Portsmouth 1-0 Stoke 
 Image source, Opta/Getty Images The hosts have been better in almost every department in the opening 45 minutes and are on course for the play-off places as things stand.
 The only way is up for the Potters, though...
 2 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Stoke have been lacklustre' published at 13:23 GMT 13:23 GMT 
 HT: Portsmouth 1-0 Stoke 
 Angela Smith 
BBC Radio Stoke summariser 
 Stoke have been lacklustre. We knew how Pompey would set up.
 One of the less enjoyable first halves of the season and hopefully they turn it on in the second half.
 I'd personally bring Justin Devenny and Sam Gallagher on.
 2 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:21 GMT 13:21 GMT 
 Use yellow button on page 
 Reffing in championship is so bad that I actually think it needs VAR. Wrexham are dirty and the ref isn’t helping. Poor Mane’s collar will be twice the size come half-time. Guessing the refs a movie fan.
 Nick, Wolves 
 29 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:19 GMT 13:19 GMT 
 Bristol City 0-1 Norwich 
 Image source, Shutterstock A chorus of boos greet the half-time whistle and it's easy to see why - Bristol City have done nowhere near enough to put the visitors under sustained pressure.
 Just one real chance for either side. The difference is that Paris Maghoma put his away and that's why Norwich go in ahead at the break.
 53 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:19 GMT 13:19 GMT 
 Wrexham 1-1 Wolves 
 Image source, Getty Images Wrexham equalise within two minutes of Wolves opener to go into the break even.
 Adam Armstrong's tidy finish from the box gave the visitors the lead but it wasn't to last.
 Issa Kabore has been the driving force of Wrexham's attacks this afternoon and gets his reward as his cross is met by Lewis O'Brien's rising head.
 Image source, Press Association 
 13 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:18 GMT 13:18 GMT 
 Wrexham 1-1 Wolves 
 There's an additional three minutes to play at the Stok Cae Ras.
 Wrexham are particularly seeming like they would like to take the lead into the tunnel and Lewis O'Brien lets loose to try and make it happen.
 Wolves stopper Jose Sa provides a firm glove to deny it.
 Red Dragons feeling in the ascendancy at the moment. They will want to get something from it before they are forced to break.
 4 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Pompey deserve to be ahead' published at 13:17 GMT 13:17 GMT 
 HT: Portsmouth 1-0 Stoke 
 Guy Whittingham 
Former Portsmouth striker and manager on BBC Radio Solent 
 If I was to be overcritical, should Pompey be 2-0 up? But they definitely deserve to be 1-0 up at the break.
 20 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:16 GMT 13:16 GMT 
 Portsmouth 1-0 Stoke 
 Image source, Getty Images Pompey's half, and then some.
 John Mousinho's only frustration will be that his side only have one goal to show for their dominance in the opening 45 minutes.
 Tyrese Shade curled the hosts into an early lead with his first Portsmouth goal just six minutes in and his side bossed the remainder of the half, with Regan Poole being denied by Viktor Johansson at his near post and the keeper also turning away a deflected Odin Bailey strike.
 Stoke have offered little as they seek to go top of the Championship but Mark Robins will be buoyed by the fact they remain in the contest.
 28 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 13:16 GMT 13:16 GMT 
 Portsmouth 1-0 Stoke 
 Regan Poole ghosts into the box to meet a low cross from the left with a first-time shot at the near post but it's deflected behind.
 Stoke are hanging on a touch but do manage to negotiate the corner.
 Poole then picks up a caution as we enter a minute of stoppage time for an overly-physical challenge on old foe Robert Bozenik under a high ball in midfield.
 5 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY APPEAL published at 13:13 GMT 13:13 GMT 
 Portsmouth 1-0 Stoke 
 Another shout for a penalty for the hosts as Junior Tchamadeu clunsily bundles into Abu Kamara on the edge of the box, two hands on his back, as a long ball bounces forward.
 Very fortunate, that, it might just have been outside the box but the Stoke man was on a yellow too.
 9 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:12 GMT 13:12 GMT 
 Wrexham 1-1 Wolves 
 Fer Lopez has been mostly contained today for Wolves but when he finally gets some space, he makes the most of it.
 He finds a destructive pass into Marshall Munetsi, who just needs to find the net. The midfielder doesn't though and lets it fly high.
 14 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:12 GMT 13:12 GMT 
 Portsmouth 1-0 Stoke 
 Another break in play as Ben Speedie summons Regan Poole and Robert Bozenik who have had a running battle in the opening 40 minutes.
 No cards, just a chat, but their physical battle is under a microscope now.
 4 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:12 GMT 13:12 GMT 
 Bristol City 0-1 Norwich 
 Norwich are looking comfortable as they protect that 1-0 lead, with the hosts still lacking quality when they get into the final third.
 Scot Twine and Lorent Tolaj combined neatly to give Rio Cardines some space, but he attempted a very ambitious shot and drilled it into the side netting.
 19 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY APPEAL published at 13:11 GMT 13:11 GMT 
 Portsmouth 1-0 Stoke 
 Pompey fans howl for a penalty after Viktor Johansson flies off his line and wipes out Ebou Adams as he tries to get a two-handed punch on a looping ball in the box after a vital defensive header from Ben Wilmot.
 Nothing doing, according to ref Ben Speedie and Adams eventually hauls himself off the deck to continue.
 11 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:10 GMT 13:10 GMT 
 Wrexham 1-1 Wolves 
 Ollie Rathbone strikes into the ground and while it's a bit messy, it causes a few heartbeats to raise.
 It bounces twice and is hard for the Wolves defences to deal with but luckily for them just goes wide.
 6 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Pendulum has swung towards Wrexham' published at 13:09 GMT 13:09 GMT 
 Wrexham 1-1 Wolves 
 Mike Taylor 
BBC WM commentator 
 It just feels like the pendulum has swung towards Wrexham a bit.
 Image source, Press Association 
 13 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 13:09 GMT 13:09 GMT 
 Portsmouth 1-0 Stoke 
 That bright and shiny yellow match-ball that we see at this time of year has seemingly been punctured and ref Ben Speedie calls for a new one.
 Pompey pick up where they left off with the old one, however, and Odin Bailey drives down the right and cuts into the box before unleashing a left-footed effort which flicks off Bosun Lawal and draws a brilliant save at his near post by Viktor Johansson.
 12 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:08 GMT 13:08 GMT 
 Use yellow button on page 
 Don't forget to let us know your thoughts on today's games. Been a good start, hasn't it??
 4 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:05 GMT 13:05 GMT 
 Wrexham 1-1 Wolves 
 There is a break in play as Wolves midfielder Marshall Munetsi receives treatment.
 A good time to point out just how influential Issa Kabore has been for Wrexham this afternoon. Almost half of their attacks have come from his side of the park.
